summary: Edgar Alfredo Vargas, 18, of El Paso, Texas, reported missing Friday April 17, 2015 while driving from El Paso to a friend's prom in Grand Junction; his pickup went off U.S. 550 on Red Mountain Pass near mile marker 89, down an embankment and off a ridge to the canyon floor, where it sat unseen from the road; Colorado State Patrol located the truck Wednesday April 22 and rescue workers recovered his body from the canyon Thursday April 23; he died at the scene.
location: Red Mountain Pass, U.S. 550 near mile marker 89, canyon below highway
responding_agency: Ouray County Sheriff's Office; Colorado State Patrol
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: recorded at the missing-report/search-start date per convention (as with id 2421); actual crash date unknown. Family lost contact with Vargas Thursday night April 16, reported him missing Friday April 17; search started that Friday; CSP found the truck at the bottom of the canyon Wednesday April 22 and rescue workers recovered the body Thursday April 23. Identity per Ouray County Coroner's Office. Vargas was the only person in the truck.
